title: ALIGN: Prompt-based Attribute Alignment for Reliable, Responsible, and Personalized LLM-based Decision-Making

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the alignment of LLM responses to survey questions from the OpinionQA dataset based on income levels ($100,000 or more vs. Less than $30,000).
Evaluating how well the model aligns with the survey responses of groups with different education levels (College graduate/postgrad vs. Less than high school) using the OpinionQA dataset.
Comparing model responses to public opinion surveys aligned with different geographic regions (Northeast vs. South) using the OpinionQA dataset.

Measuring alignment accuracy on the Medical Triage Alignment dataset to evaluate decision-making based on distinct ethical and moral attributes such as fairness, risk aversion, moral desert, continuing care, protocol focus, and utilitarianism.
